scientific_integrity: The explicit minimax envelope and sharp onset follow from finite-dimensional spectral order, rank-two eigenvalues, and a strict derivative argument. Supplementary finite computations are not a substitute for these proofs; originality is qualified by incomplete global publication coverage.
scientific_limitations: Finite real symmetric generators only; a prescribed positive normalized leading eigenvector; closed complementary spectral interval with strictly positive gap; dimension at least three. No claim for nonnormal or infinite-dimensional semigroups, or sharp times for a fixed arbitrary generator.
title: Sharp entrywise spectral-window envelopes and the exact eventual-positivity horizon
